title: Local nitrogen chemistry in a ruthenium ammonia-oxidation model
difficulty_reasons: Coordination and electronic states must be established for the specified local molecular inventory.
Comparing local reactivity requires consistent energetic references and a molecular explanation of the ligand role.

data.description: Molecular component graphs, the Ru–bda–Py local nitrogen inventory with charge +1, NH3, MeCN conditions and supplied electrolysis observations.

required_deliverables.description: Structured scientific evidence and research record.
Readable results, interpretation and limitations with artifact links.
